findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: federation_attest, federation_prompt_run, federation_offer, federation_catalog_platforms, federation_view, federation_enter_tenant · Private data: federation_tenant_info, federation_journal_read, federation_attest, federation_prompt_run, federation_key_status, federation_offer, federation_governance, legal_get, federation_arena, federation_latency, federation_view, federation_solvency · Public sink: federation_pricesheet, federation_catalog_platforms, federation_view, federation_enter_tenant · Destructive: federation_journal_read, federation_act, federation_prompt_run, federation_help, federation_catalog_platforms, federation_arena, federation_search, introspection_prompt_library.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: federation_attest, federation_prompt_run, federation_offer, federation_catalog_platforms, federation_view, federation_enter_tenant · Private data: federation_tenant_info, federation_journal_read, federation_attest, federation_prompt_run, federation_key_status, federation_offer, federation_governance, legal_get, federation_arena, federation_latency, federation_view, federation_solvency · Public sink: federation_pricesheet, federation_catalog_platforms, federation_view, federation_enter_tenant · Destructive: federation_journal_read, federation_act, federation_prompt_run, federation_help, federation_catalog_platforms, federation_arena, federation_search, introspection_prompt_library

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
